summary: Western Copper and Gold Corporation filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a foreign private issuer's interim current report) furnishing its unaudited condensed interim consolidated financial statements, MD&A and CEO/CFO certifications for the period ended September 30, 2026. No transaction terms are disclosed. Balance sheet shows cash of C$26.6M, short-term investments of C$94.0M and an exploration and evaluation asset of C$164.2M, against C$8.8M of liabilities. Net loss for the nine months widened to C$5.9M on higher wages and share-based payments. Routine periodic reporting; no deal, no risk-arb angle.
